name: prompt-submit-skill-router
description: Injects registry-driven skill, plugin, MCP, and hook routing guidance when a Codex prompt is submitted.

interface.shortDescription: Routes prompts from the capability registry
interface.longDescription: Adds model-visible pre-run routing guidance from the submitted prompt, recent router logs, and the project capability registry so Codex can choose relevant skills, plugin-backed workflows, MCP/app connectors, and hooks without an explicit router prompt.
defaultPrompt: Route my next prompt to the right skills
Explain which skills this request should use
